standard_prerequisites.name: Sheaf condition on X: sections on an open set are determined by compatible sections on the members of an open covering
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the sheaf property of F that transfers along the covering f^{-1}(V_j).

core_obligations: Let V = union V_j be an open covering in Y (proof lines 2241-2242). By continuity the preimages satisfy f^{-1}(V) = union f^{-1}(V_j), an open covering in X (proof lines 2242-2243). The sheaf condition for f_*F on the covering V_j asks for gluing of sections of F on the opens f^{-1}(V_j) with compatibility on f^{-1}(V_j) intersect f^{-1}(V_k) = f^{-1}(V_j intersect V_k); this is exactly the sheaf condition of F on the covering f^{-1}(V_j), which holds (proof lines 2243-2244). Hence f_*F is a sheaf on Y (proof lines 2240-2244).
proof_roadmap: Take an open covering in Y and pass to preimages, an open covering in X (proof lines 2241-2243).
Read the sheaf condition of F on the preimage covering as the sheaf condition of f_*F (proof lines 2243-2244).
